basic_details.short_information: District Climate Change Mission, Tiruppur (DCCM Tiruppur) has announced 1 contract vacancy for the post of Technical Assistant. content_sections.heading: DCCM Tiruppur Technical Assistant at a Glance

rows.details: Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy or similar relevant disciplines

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may submit their application by email or in person. Email Submission: Send the application to [email protected] with the email subject: Application for Technical Assisstant, District Climate Change Mission, Tiruppur. In-Person Submission: The District Forest Officer, Through Forest Range Office, Room No.649, 6th floor, Tiruppur Collector office Building, Palladam Road, Tiruppur-641604.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy or similar relevant disciplines from a recognised University/Institution. Basic type writing skills in both Tamil and English. The Candidate should be a Resident of Tiruppur District. The candidate should not have completed 40 years of age as on 01.10.2026. Candidates having at least one year of relevant work experience preferably in a Government Department / Government Office may be given first preference. Experience in Data Entry, compilation, tabulation, office documentation and Data Management. Experience in official file maintenance, record keeping and documentation. Ability to prepare official reports, letters, and PowerPoint presentations. Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel and MS Powerpoint.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Tiruppur Technical Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordination and synergy among line departments for environmental protection and climate action. Coordination and Documentation of DCCM activities and capacity-building programmes. Documentation of successful climate adaptation and mitigation initiatives. Acting as a link between the Department of Environment and Climate Change at State level and the DCCM at district level. Organising DCCM meetings once every two months and preparation/submission of Minutes of Meeting. Reviewing innovations and existing schemes relating to Environment and Climate Change. Planning upcoming activities and stakeholder engagements. Assisting in organising District Level Climate Resilient Capacity Building Workshops. Preparation and maintenance of files, reports, photographs, videography, expenditure statements and other documentation relating to DCCM Schemes and activities. Perform any other duties assigned in connection with the activities of the District Climate Change Mission.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Resume/CV Aadhaar card Certificates relating to educational qualification Work experience certificates (if any) Typing qualification documents Other relevant documents

content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on the prescribed eligibility criteria and will be called for an In-Person Interview and Typing Test. A waiting list of 2–3 candidates will also be maintained as per the DCCM Guidelines.
